$comment: BEAN FX M42-C/G editing-style recipes. Every field maps to a REAL editor capability: effects must be members of EffectType (src/lib/editor/model.ts), keyframe params of KeyframeProperty, transitions of TransitionKind, caption styles of CaptionStyleSchema. 'needs' lists capabilities that require analysis/generation not guaranteed locally — the style engine discloses them and offers alternatives; it never fabricates the effect.

recipes.name: Movie trailer
recipes.purpose: High-impact promotional cut that builds momentum to a climax and ends on a title or sting.
recipes.shotSelection: lead with the most visually striking wide; end sections on motion vectors that match the next shot's direction

pacing.acceleration: monotonic within acts; hold longest take in the quiet beat before the climax

color.note: sample shot-matched amounts, never a fixed LUT

audio.bed: steady pulse; risers before act breaks (needs asset or MCP sound tool)

captions.style: title-card upper thirds; no dialogue captions unless requested

needs: music bed asset or MCP sound-design tool
title graphic (editor captions or MCP design tool)
qualityChecks: no accidental repetition of the same shot twice in a row
recipes.promptExample: Turn all these clips into a 45-second cinematic trailer.

recipes.name: Cinematic storytelling
recipes.purpose: Narrative-driven edit that reads like a short film: establishing → development → resolution.
recipes.shotSelection: establishing wide first; hold human subjects longer than scenery; sequence by continuity of motion and light

pacing.acceleration: none — steady breath

color.note: natural-first; match shots across scenes

needs: user-provided footage with coverage for the intended emotional beats (media prerequisite — no engine capability required)
qualityChecks: no 6+ s static wide unless intentional
recipes.promptExample: Create a documentary-style edit with a strong story.

recipes.name: Instagram Reel
recipes.purpose: Vertical, hook-first short: retain past second 2, deliver payoff fast, loop cleanly.
recipes.shotSelection: strongest expression/motion frame first; vertical-safe crops (subject in upper 2/3)

pacing.acceleration: front-loaded — fastest cuts in the first 5 s

color.note: bright, clean; protect skin tones

captions.style: word/near-word social captions, BOTTOM or CENTER, large font, high-contrast background

needs: ASR for captions when dialogue exists (fallback: manual text)
qualityChecks: safe-area respected (no caption under UI chrome)
loop: last frame cuts back to first cleanly
recipes.promptExample: Make a professional Instagram Reel from these videos.

recipes.name: Interview documentary
recipes.purpose: Credible testimony-driven edit: the words lead, images support.
recipes.shotSelection: keep talking-head takes with natural blinks/breath; cutaways on statement boundaries; never cut mid-word

pacing.acceleration: follow the speech rhythm, not a metronome

color.note: documentary realism — minimal grade

audio.ducking: music never above speech; room tone continuity

captions.style: documentary subtitles, BOTTOM, moderate font, speaker labels if diarization is available

needs: diarization only via an approved provider (disclosed)
qualityChecks: no sentence truncated at a cut
cutaway does not contradict the spoken content
recipes.promptExample: Remove silences and mistakes, retain the important dialogue and create accurate captions.

recipes.name: Wedding highlight
recipes.purpose: Emotional arc from preparation → vows → celebration; the couple's words carry the story.
recipes.shotSelection: hands, glances, vows; guests' reactions as punctuation; golden-hour frames for the turn

pacing.acceleration: gentle; lift pace only for the dance floor

color.note: warm, gentle; protect white dress highlights

qualityChecks: no jarring cut on the couple's emotional peak
recipes.promptExample: Edit this wedding footage into a beautiful emotional highlight film.

recipes.name: Gaming highlights
recipes.purpose: Skill-forward montage: eliminations, clutch moments, reaction spikes.
recipes.shotSelection: kill/conflict first frames; HUD readable; avoid repeated identical spawns

pacing.acceleration: peak pace in the final third

audio.ducking: SFX spikes over music; comms kept when meaningful

captions.style: hype word captions optional, TOP to avoid HUD

needs: audio-event detection for kill sounds (GANGZII/analysis) or manual range markers
qualityChecks: no dead respawn time left in
speed ramps return to 1.0 before the next cut
recipes.promptExample: Make this gaming video more entertaining with fast cuts, zooms and sound effects.

recipes.name: Product advertisement
recipes.purpose: Problem → product as hero → benefit proof → call to action.
recipes.shotSelection: product beauty frames centered; feature close-ups get the longest holds

pacing.acceleration: steady; CTA slows down

color.note: clean commercial look; whites clean, no color cast on packaging

recipes.promptExample: Create a professional product advertisement.

recipes.name: Tutorial / how-to
recipes.purpose: Teach one outcome clearly: steps, close-ups on the action, captions for accessibility.
recipes.shotSelection: the action area fills the frame; the result of each step shown before moving on

pacing.acceleration: none inside a step; trim pauses BETWEEN steps

highlightZoom.use: on the exact UI element being taught

color.note: legibility first

qualityChecks: every step's result visible before the next
recipes.promptExample: Create captions and make the tutorial tighter without losing the steps.

recipes.name: Music-video montage
recipes.purpose: Beat-synced visual rhythm: cuts land on transients, sections follow song structure.
recipes.shotSelection: movement-heavy frames on strong beats; holds on the downbeat of section changes

pacing.acceleration: locked to the track's energy curve

color.note: style shot-matching within sections

captions.style: none or lyric callouts (karaoke only with aligned lyrics)

needs: beat/onset analysis (librosa-based tool or MCP audio tool) for exact sync — disclosed when unavailable
qualityChecks: cuts land on beats ±1 frame at section boundaries
no cut mid-gesture on the hook
recipes.promptExample: Make the footage cinematic, improve the colors, synchronize cuts with the music and add suitable transitions.

recipes.name: Sports highlights
recipes.purpose: Outcome-first recap: score moments, saves, reactions — with slow-motion replays.
structure: cold open on the decisive moment
recipes.shotSelection: ball/player at the moment of contact; crowd reactions as connective tissue

pacing.acceleration: rises to the final

replayRamp.note: real playbackSpeed change for the replay

needs: motion/impact detection for moment finding, or user-provided markers
qualityChecks: no offside/illegal moment glorified by mistake
replay returns to real time before the next cut
recipes.promptExample: Create the season highlights with slow-motion replays.

recipes.name: Vertical 9:16 conversion
recipes.purpose: Reframe an existing 16:9 edit for vertical delivery while keeping subjects centered and captions safe.
recipes.shotSelection: subject-aware crop windows per clip; motion follows the subject

animatedReframe.note: animated x keyframes when the subject moves — real SetKeyframe on x

captions.style: re-flow captions for the 9:16 safe area

needs: subject-position analysis for smart crops (frame sampling + motion analysis); without it, center-crop with disclosure
qualityChecks: subject fully in frame across the clip
no caption below the bottom safe line
recipes.promptExample: Change the current edit into a vertical 9:16 version.

recipes.name: Podcast video
recipes.purpose: Conversation-first edit: trim dead air, punch in on the speaker, chapter the flow.
recipes.shotSelection: speaker punch-ins on statement starts; listener reactions; no cut mid-word

pacing.acceleration: trim silences > 1.2 s

color.note: clean, consistent across cameras

qualityChecks: punch-in lands on the new speaker within 0.5 s
recipes.promptExample: Remove the silences and punch in on whoever is talking.

recipes.name: Investigative documentary
recipes.purpose: Evidence-led long-form cut that lets testimony and documents carry the argument, with restrained visual reinforcement.
structure: cold open on the sharpest evidence (0-5%)
recipes.shotSelection: privilege stable, well-lit testimony; cut to supporting b-roll EXACTLY when the speaker names the object or place; never cut mid-claim

pacing.acceleration: flat; brief acceleration only in the cold open

color.note: keep testimony color faithful — grade b-roll to match, never stylize evidence

audio.ducking: music sits −12 to −18 dB under speech, full level in chapter transitions
audio.bed: sparse ambient pads; no percussion during testimony

captions.style: lower-third name straps on first appearance; verbatim captions

qualityChecks: no cut interrupts a sentence mid-claim
name straps verified against approved spelling
no stylized grading on testimony shots
recipes.promptExample: Cut this investigation footage into a 12-minute documentary chapter — testimony leads, documents support, nothing invented.

recipes.name: Travel documentary
recipes.purpose: Location-led storytelling that balances scenery, people and narration with a clear sense of place.
recipes.shotSelection: pair every wide with a human-scale detail; keep skyline reveals slow, food and hands shots short

pacing.acceleration: gently accelerating across each location movement, reset between locations

color.note: warm the sunlit shots, keep interiors neutral

audio.ducking: narration and interview audio always above ambience
audio.bed: location ambience carried across cuts to glue geography

captions.style: location name straps; optional bilingual captions

qualityChecks: no jump cut within one location
audio ambience does not clash between locations
recipes.promptExample: Edit this travel footage into a 6-minute documentary chapter with location name straps and warm grade.

recipes.name: Corporate documentary
recipes.purpose: Credible company story combining leadership interviews, workplace b-roll and outcome shots.
recipes.shotSelection: every claim from an interview is followed by evidence b-roll; avoid stock-symmetric compositions

pacing.acceleration: flat with a modest lift in the final act

color.note: brand-neutral grade; match interview and b-roll color temperature

audio.ducking: dialogue first; music only in transitions

captions.style: title card + name straps; verbatim captions

qualityChecks: no unsubstantiated marketing claim left unpaired with footage
no accidental competitor branding in frame
recipes.promptExample: Turn these interviews and office shots into a 5-minute corporate documentary.

recipes.name: YouTube Shorts hook-first
recipes.purpose: Vertical short whose first two seconds justify the watch; loop-friendly structure.
structure: looping close (85-100% — last frame must plausibly precede the first)
recipes.shotSelection: open on the most visually arresting mid-action frame, never a title card; center-weight framing for UI overlays

pacing.acceleration: fast start, slight deceleration into the payoff

color.note: punchy but skin-tone safe

audio.bed: trend audio only if the user owns rights to it

captions.style: centered bold word captions, 2-4 words per card

needs: transcription for word captions (phrase timing disclosed)
qualityChecks: no dead frame before the hook
last frame can loop into the first
recipes.promptExample: Cut this into a 45-second vertical Short with a strong mid-action hook and loop close.

recipes.name: TikTok trend remix
recipes.purpose: Trend-native remix following a platform pattern (transitions on beat, caption rhythm, loop).
recipes.shotSelection: cut exactly ON beat markers; keep each clip long enough to read, short enough to breathe

pacing.acceleration: beat-locked; brief slow-motion accent before the twist

color.note: trend-native punch; keep faces readable

audio.ducking: trend audio is the master; original audio ducked or muted
audio.bed: user-owned trend audio only — licensing is the user's responsibility

needs: beat markers (manual or beat analysis when available)
qualityChecks: caption rhythm matches the audio pattern
recipes.promptExample: Remix these clips to this beat — every cut on beat, loop the ending.

recipes.name: UGC testimonial
recipes.purpose: Authentic user-generated-style endorsement: raw-feel but tightly structured.
recipes.shotSelection: keep the authentic imperfection; stabilise ONLY when shake distracts; product hero shots get the polish

pacing.acceleration: conversational, accelerating after the discovery beat

color.note: light touch — overgrading kills UGC authenticity

audio.ducking: voice dominant; light bed under CTA

qualityChecks: speaker's words never paraphrased in captions
recipes.promptExample: Assemble these customer clips into a 40-second UGC-style testimonial with honest captions.

recipes.name: Day-in-the-life vlog
recipes.purpose: Chronological personal narrative with time-of-day rhythm and personality-forward narration.
recipes.shotSelection: one anchor shot per chapter; narration on top; keep brems honest (do not fake continuity across days)

pacing.acceleration: steady; slight lift at chapter starts

color.note: morning warm → afternoon neutral → evening cool, if footage allows

audio.ducking: voice over bed; ambience kept for place-feel

qualityChecks: chapter order matches the clock (no accidental time travel)
recipes.promptExample: Assemble this day footage into a vlog with three chapters and my narration on top.

recipes.name: Podcast highlights
recipes.purpose: Clip the strongest moments of a long recording into shareable highlight segments.
structure: cold-open on the sharpest quote (0-3 s)
recipes.shotSelection: anchor on the speaker at the peak line; reaction shots only when they carry emotion

pacing.acceleration: flat — the words carry it

color.note: faithful multi-cam match

audio.bed: no music bed under the moment; sting allowed at open/close

needs: diarization NOT available — speaker labels only when the user provides them
qualityChecks: clip stands alone without the full episode
recipes.promptExample: Pull the three strongest moments from this podcast recording into vertical clips with captions.

recipes.name: Stream recap
recipes.purpose: Compress hours of stream VOD into a highlights reel around the peak plays and reactions.
structure: cold open on the best play (0-3 s)
recipes.shotSelection: gameplay carries; facecam reaction cut in AT the peak moment; kill repeated failed attempts

pacing.acceleration: escalating with the stakes

color.note: crisp gameplay; light sharpen on downscaled VOD

audio.ducking: game audio under reactions at peaks
audio.bed: user-owned music; SFX spikes need assets

captions.style: callouts for scores/kills; word captions for reactions

needs: moment detection is MANUAL (no automatic highlight model — disclosed)
qualityChecks: no spoiler of the final play in the cold open
recipes.promptExample: Turn this stream VOD into a 3-minute recap with clutch zooms and reaction cut-ins.

recipes.name: E-commerce product demo
recipes.purpose: Conversion-focused demo: show the product solving the problem in the first five seconds.
recipes.shotSelection: product occupies ≥ 40% of frame in every shot; hands and faces support, never compete

pacing.acceleration: even; slight lift before CTA

color.note: clean commercial whites; true-to-product color (never oversaturate a color the buyer will judge)

audio.ducking: VO leads; SFX on feature reveals

qualityChecks: product color faithful to reference photo
every feature claim shown in footage
recipes.promptExample: Cut these product clips into a 30-second demo with feature callouts and a CTA card.

recipes.name: Luxury brand film
recipes.purpose: Slow, composed craft piece where negative space and sound design signal quality.
recipes.shotSelection: longest, most composed takes; movement enters and exits frame; nothing rushed

pacing.acceleration: flat — restraint IS the luxury

color.note: deep controlled blacks, restrained saturation, gentle vignette

captions.style: typographic title card; serif-aligned brand text

needs: NO stock LUT bundles — grade is authored per project
recipes.promptExample: Make a 90-second luxury film from these craft shots — slow, deep blacks, one title card.

recipes.name: Food commercial
recipes.purpose: Appetite-forward cut: texture, steam, cheese-pulls; motion that makes food feel alive.
recipes.shotSelection: close and closer: textures dominate; hands add humanity; steam/pour shots are anchors

pacing.acceleration: building heat toward the final plate

color.note: warm and appetizing; never green-shift skin or plates

audio.ducking: SFX (sizzle/pour) at the moments they show

qualityChecks: food never looks cold in a warm claim
hero bite lands in the first 3 s
recipes.promptExample: Make these cooking shots into a 30-second food ad — hero bite first, sizzle sync, warm grade.

recipes.name: Real estate tour
recipes.purpose: Property walkthrough with stable camera motion, room-to-room logic and measurement honesty.
recipes.shotSelection: stable moving shots (stabilized when needed); every room entered in one move; details 1-2 s

pacing.acceleration: flat, unhurried

color.note: bright and true — windows handled honestly, no fake views

needs: stabilization for shaky walkthroughs (real libvidstab available)
qualityChecks: room order matches the floor plan
square footage claims match the listing
no clutter left in frame that misrepresents the space
recipes.promptExample: Assemble this walkthrough into a 90-second property tour with room straps and a contact card.

recipes.name: App demo screencast
recipes.purpose: UI-first demonstration with honest capture, zooms to detail and no faked interactions.
recipes.shotSelection: full UI for orientation, zoomed crops for detail (via scale/x/y keyframes on the SAME capture — never redrawn UI)

pacing.acceleration: flat and predictable

pushIn.use: zoom to the exact UI region (x/y + scale keyframes)

color.note: keep UI text crisp; no color shifts on interface colors

needs: zoom keyframes on real captures (never mocked-up UI)
qualityChecks: every click shown actually happens in the capture
no mouse teleport across cuts (match cuts only)
runtime matches the real task duration (no faked speed)
recipes.promptExample: Turn this screen recording into a 2-minute app walkthrough with zooms to each control.

recipes.name: Startup pitch video
recipes.purpose: Investor-facing narrative: problem, insight, product proof, traction, ask.
recipes.shotSelection: founder credibility shots + product proof; metric graphics only for real numbers

pacing.acceleration: rising through traction

color.note: confident, brand-aligned, no gimmicks

qualityChecks: demo footage shows the real product
recipes.promptExample: Edit this pitch footage into a 3-minute investor video with metric callouts from my deck numbers.

recipes.name: Engagement film
recipes.purpose: Intimate proposal/engagement story told with restraint — the emotion is in the people, not the effects.
recipes.shotSelection: faces first; the proposal itself uninterrupted; details as breathing room

pacing.acceleration: flat — let the moment breathe

color.note: romantic warmth without skin-tone drift

qualityChecks: the proposal moment is NEVER cut mid-action
no crying face held uncomfortably long
no guest filmed unflatteringly without consent
recipes.promptExample: Edit this proposal footage into a 3-minute engagement film — the moment stays whole.

recipes.name: Conference recap
recipes.purpose: Energy-compressed event summary: stage moments, audience, hallway color.
recipes.shotSelection: peak talk lines + clapping reactions; slides only when legible (or use their real deck exports)

pacing.acceleration: energetic with breathing room between sessions

color.note: stage lighting is mixed — balance exposure, don't repaint brand colors

audio.ducking: talk audio leads; applause kept natural

qualityChecks: no attendee identifiable against their wishes (organizer policy)
recipes.promptExample: Cut this conference footage into a 2-minute recap with talk straps and crowd energy.

recipes.name: Fitness training edit
recipes.purpose: Motivational training edit: effort visible, form readable, progression felt.
recipes.shotSelection: form readable in every rep shot; sweat/effort close-ups earn the progression; no fake-weight trickery

pacing.acceleration: with the music; brief slow-motion on the hardest rep

color.note: gritty and energetic; keep skin tones honest under gym lighting

captions.style: rep counters (real counts only) + cue captions

recipes.promptExample: Make a 60-second training edit from these gym clips — beat cuts, slow-mo on the hardest rep.

recipes.name: Lyric video
recipes.purpose: Text-led music piece where lyrics arrive exactly on their sung moments.
recipes.shotSelection: backgrounds are mood plates — slow motion or stills; text is the star and never fights the image

pacing.acceleration: with the song's energy map

color.note: text contrast is the priority — darken or desaturate plates as needed

audio.bed: the song itself (user must own or license it)

captions.style: synced lyric lines; verified against the actual audio

needs: lyric text from the rights holder
caption timing verified against the waveform
qualityChecks: every line appears when sung (±2 frames)
no copyrighted lyric text without rights
recipes.promptExample: Build a lyric video for my track — lines on the sung moments over these mood plates.

recipes.name: Beat-synced montage
recipes.purpose: Pure rhythm piece: every cut and accent locked to the music's energy.
recipes.shotSelection: motion-vector matching across cuts; direction continuity (left→left→left) then reversal on the drop

pacing.acceleration: beat-locked with a deliberate breakdown

color.note: energy-forward; consistent look across sources is mandatory

needs: beat markers (manual or beat analysis when available)
qualityChecks: motion direction flows across at least 4-shot runs
breakdown lands where the music does
no orphan frame before a cut
recipes.promptExample: Sync-cut these clips to my track — every cut on the beat, direction flows, drop hits hardest.

recipes.name: Explainer lecture
recipes.purpose: Teach one concept cleanly: claim → visual proof → recap, with honest pacing for comprehension.
recipes.shotSelection: speaker framed consistently; every abstract claim gets a concrete visual; slides only when legible

pacing.acceleration: flat; intentional pauses after key claims

color.note: neutral and readable; diagrams never color-shifted

qualityChecks: every claim has a visual within 5 s
recipes.promptExample: Edit this lecture into a clean explainer — claims on screen, recap at the end, verbatim captions.

recipes.name: Software walkthrough
recipes.purpose: Task-complete software tutorial: every step shown in real capture with honest timing.
recipes.shotSelection: full-window for orientation; zoom (scale/x/y keyframes on the real capture) for small controls; never mock UI

pacing.acceleration: flat; allow reading time

color.note: interface text stays crisp and color-true

qualityChecks: each numbered step appears in the capture in order
recipes.promptExample: Cut this screen capture into a numbered walkthrough — zoom to each control, honest timing.

recipes.name: Kinetic typography
recipes.purpose: Words carry the film: type moves with the voice/music using frame-exact keyframes.
recipes.shotSelection: n/a — text plates and NIIKI graphics tracks carry the picture; images only as accents

pacing.acceleration: locked to the voice/music rhythm

color.note: high text contrast; backgrounds minimal

captions.style: the kinetic text IS the caption track (kept in sync)

qualityChecks: text sync within ±2 frames of speech
recipes.promptExample: Animate this voiceover as kinetic typography — words land on the beat, high contrast.

recipes.name: Data infographic video
recipes.purpose: Numbers made visual and honest: real data, animated counters and charts that never mislead.
recipes.shotSelection: one dataset per beat; axis/labels legible; animated counters count REAL values

pacing.acceleration: flat — comprehension first

color.note: charts keep their authored colors — never grade the data

qualityChecks: every number traceable to the provided data
source card present at the end
counters end at the real values
recipes.promptExample: Animate my quarterly numbers into a 60-second infographic — counters end at the real values.

recipes.name: Glitch art edit
recipes.purpose: Deliberate corruption aesthetics: datamosh-flavored cuts, channel shifts, frame drops — all honest about technique.
recipes.shotSelection: high-contrast, motion-heavy sources; corruption reads best on detail-rich frames

pacing.acceleration: escalating with the corruption

color.note: channel-shift look is approximated in preview via CSS filters and renders via the eq/colorbalance chain — disclosed approximation

captions.style: corrupted-style text IF legibility is still met

needs: disclosure: true datamosh needs codec-level manipulation — NOT available; the look is approximated with real filters
qualityChecks: glitch moments land on audio hits
at least one clean anchor shot per act
no seizure-risk strobing longer than 0.2 s at full field
recipes.promptExample: Make a glitch edit from these night shots — corruption on the drops, clean anchors between.

recipes.name: Slow cinema art film
recipes.purpose: Contemplative long-take piece where duration itself is the language.
recipes.shotSelection: longest takes only; nothing narrated into it; composition does the work — no insert-cutting to rescue pacing

pacing.acceleration: none — stillness is the point

color.note: naturalistic, painterly restraint

needs: long takes in the source (cannot be faked — disclosed)
recipes.promptExample: Assemble these long takes into a slow-cinema piece — minimal cuts, held endings.

recipes.name: Horror / suspense
recipes.purpose: Dread through negative space, sound and withheld information.
recipes.shotSelection: show LESS than the viewer wants; reaction shots over reveals; the turn happens off-screen or in one unbroken move

pacing.acceleration: decelerate INTO the turn (silence before shock)

color.note: cool, crushed shadows with detail intact — never a grey mush

audio.ducking: silence is a weapon — drop the bed before the turn
audio.bed: drone/room tone; stingers need user-owned SFX

needs: dim footage (cannot fake night from day honestly — disclosed)
qualityChecks: the turn lands after a deliberate silence
recipes.promptExample: Cut this footage into a suspense piece — withhold the reveal, silence before the turn.

recipes.name: Comedy timing edit
recipes.purpose: Rhythm-driven comedy: the cut IS the punchline — reactions land late on purpose.
recipes.shotSelection: wide for the setup, tight for the reaction; hold the dead air AFTER the punchline (it is the joke)

pacing.acceleration: comedic timing beats — hold, then snap

color.note: bright and present; comedy dies in mud

audio.ducking: dialogue sacred; bed drops OUT before punchlines

captions.style: caption the punchline exactly as spoken

qualityChecks: setup never winks at the joke
recipes.promptExample: Edit this sketch for comedy — hold the reaction after the punchline, snap zoom on the tag.

recipes.name: News package
recipes.purpose: Broadcast-style package: anchor/nat-sound lead, b-roll proof, tight ethical labeling.
recipes.shotSelection: nat-sound opens; every factual claim paired with real footage or honest archival labeling

pacing.acceleration: steady broadcast rhythm

color.note: broadcast-neutral; archival material labeled, never blended invisibly

audio.bed: none — news uses no music bed (standard practice)

qualityChecks: no claim without footage or attribution
recipes.promptExample: Assemble this into a 90-second news package — actuality first, archival labeled, no music bed.
